Wildwood 4K Steelbook Preorders Now: Animated Film's Physical Release Details

Laika Studios’ stop-motion animated film *Wildwood* is making its way into homes through physical media, with 4K steelbook preorders now live. Fans eager to own a piece of the film’s handmade world can secure the limited-edition release before it sells out, alongside standard and Blu-ray options. Covering the intersection of commerce and pop culture, this release falls within IGN's ongoing coverage of upcoming 4K Blu-ray and media release schedules, which also track video game and LEGO set drops.

Preorder Formats and Pricing

The limited-edition 4K steelbook is currently available for preorder at $39.99, while the 4K standard edition retails for $36.99 and the Blu-ray for $27.99. All formats are available through major retailers including Amazon, Gruv, and Walmart. Purchasing the higher-tier formats offers fans a more immersive viewing experience, taking advantage of modern 4K resolution capabilities, though the Blu-ray remains a solid entry point for those prioritizing budget.

A Stop-Motion Masterpiece

*Wildwood* arrives with a star-studded voice cast, featuring Carey Mulligan, Mahershala Ali, Jacob Tremblay, Awkwafina, Angela Bassett, Charlie Day, Jemaine Clement, and the iconic Tom Waits. Rated PG-13 for intense sequences of sci-fi violence and some thematic elements, the film appeals to a wide range of ages due to its fable-like quality. The story follows a boy abducted into an enchanted forest, prompting his teenage sister Prue and her classmate Curtis to embark on a search mission.

In his review, IGN critic Tom Jorgensen highlighted the film's craftsmanship: “Wildwood is an arresting, exciting fantasy epic made all the more impressive by the fact that its fully realized and well-thought out world is handmade and hand-animated. The craft on display from Laika and director Travis Knight through this story of grief and growing up is commendable, and Wildwood’s massive sense of both scale and whimsy are constant joys.”

Laika is no stranger to stop-motion, having previously produced *Coraline*, *ParaNorman*, *The Boxtrolls*, *Kubo and the Two Strings*, and *Missing Link*. *Wildwood* continues this tradition, imbuing real emotional weight thanks to the expressiveness of the stop-motion characters. For fans of physical media and limited releases, this marks a significant addition to the studio's catalog.

What Remains Unknown

As of now, specific details regarding the included bonus materials remain undisclosed. Additionally, the exact theatrical release date has not yet been confirmed, as it depends on the film's performance in theaters. Both of these details are expected to be clarified in the future. Readers following the release schedule can monitor IGN's upcoming 4K UHD Blu-ray release dates for further updates.

For readers interested in what else is coming for home media, upcoming releases also include *Clayface* and *The Odyssey*, as well as new 4K editions of the original *Die Hard* trilogy.
